issues.description: Visibility mismatch for Course.addRating(stars:). The problem statement (and the template) expect an instance method addRating(stars:) declared in an extension and callable from client code. The template provides an extension with func addRating(stars: Int) (internal by default). However, the solution implementation marks this method as private (solution_repository/Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift lines 24-29) while the client code calls swiftCourse.addRating(stars:) (solution_repository/Sources/DeveloperLib/Client.swift lines 14-15). Declaring addRating as private prevents the Client (in a different file) from calling it and would cause a compile-time access control error. This contradicts the intended design and will block students or break the provided solution when run.
issues.suggested_fix: Make addRating(stars:) accessible to the client code by removing the private modifier in the solution (i.e., declare it as func addRating(stars: Int) { ... } or mark it public/fileprivate as appropriate). The simplest fix is to remove 'private' so the method has internal visibility like the template, matching the problem statement and allowing Client to call it.
